title: verify() rejects unsigned SignerInfo (no signed_attrs) silently as per-signer failure
description: verify.rs line 161: when signed_attrs is absent, verify_one returns fail(..., 'no signed attributes present'). RFC 5652 §5.4 permits absent signed_attrs for direct signature over content. The crate silently rejects these; callers get AllSignersFailed with a non-obvious error. This is a documented limitation but callers will file issues when they encounter CMS blobs from older systems that use unsigned SignerInfos. Fix: document this limitation explicitly in the verify() public doc.
